card.name: Linking words before number terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, in, by and same that come right before a number-related term like whole numbers, decimal, or numbers. It appears in math teaching and computing text about number systems.

modes.label: Of or with before whole numbers
modes.description: The word of or with sits right before whole numbers or systems of numeration in math instruction.
modes.example: The procedure for the division of decimals is very similar to the division<< of>> whole numbers.

modes.label: In or by before number base terms
modes.description: A small word like in or by comes before decimal, binary or similar number-format terms in computing text.
modes.example: 000 through 111 in binary, which is 0 through 7<< in>> decimal.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward number-related continuations such as numerical, large, and comma.
card.plain: It marks the small word just before a number word, such as whole numbers or decimal, in math and computing text.
